waypoints.name: Stuart Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US 2 at the west edge of Leavenworth, turn onto Icicle Creek Road and drive about 8.4 miles, then turn left onto FS Road 7601 and follow the rough, potholed dirt road about 3.7 miles to its end at the Stuart Lake Trailhead, about 3,400 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass is required to park; day trips need the free self-issued Enchantments day-use permit at the trailhead, and overnight stays need a quota permit.

waypoints.name: Prusik Peak south face base
waypoints.directions: Hike the Stuart Lake Trail about 2.5 miles, turn right onto the Colchuck Lake Trail, cross Mountaineer Creek and switchback to Colchuck Lake at 5,570 ft. From the boulder field at the south end climb Aasgard Pass, about 2,000 ft of loose scree, then cross the upper Core past Tranquil and Isolation Lakes and go cross-country over slabs and talus to Gnome Tarn, about 20 minutes below the south face.

waypoints.name: Prusik Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Start about 50 ft left of the standard South Face line, on an easy left-slanting crack leading to a stembox; the 5.11+ crux comes on the first pitch, which ends at a two-bolt anchor. Six pitches of crack and corner climbing follow, finishing in a chimney with a loose block before the top.
